title: DeBakey and Stanford — dissection
alt: Four aortic schematics: DeBakey I and II with ascending involvement; IIIa above and IIIb below the diaphragm. Classic I/II correspond to Stanford A and III to B, unless retrograde ascending involvement is present.
caption: Original reporting schematic. Classify dissection only; these labels do not classify an uncomplicated aneurysm.

source.title: ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guideline — classifications and reporting

title: Crawford / Safi — thoracoabdominal aneurysm extent
alt: Segment chart of Crawford I to IV and Safi V relative to the left subclavian, diaphragm, renal arteries and bifurcation.
caption: Original extent schematic; describe actual branch-vessel relationships and endpoints in the report.

source.title: ACC/AHA 2022 aortic disease guideline — classifications and reporting
